cards.title: Moon Muffin Market Viewpoint Flip
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable pencil-case card for choosing who tells a pretend moon market moment: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, place two pencils like a paper switch, and name two pretend tellers: a moon muffin sign and a pocket eraser: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Circle one teller, write one sentence, then flip the paper switch and tell the same moment another way: ____________________.
cards.switchFrontPrompt: Front switch: The moon muffin sign says, 'I notice ____________________ first.'
cards.switchBackPrompt: Back switch: The pocket eraser says, 'I would gently fix ____________________.'
cards.storySwitchPrompt: Story switch: Swap the storyteller from sign to eraser, but keep the market moment pretend: ____________________.
cards.firstLineSwitch: First line switch: 'At Moon Muffin Market, my pencil case opened and ____________________ began to tell the story.'
cards.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Add one clue that shows who is talking without naming them: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Point to the teller you choose and write only one word clue: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Reuse the card to retell a moon market moment from a new pencil-case voice: ____________________.

cards.title: Puddle Planet Parcel Object Swap
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable pencil-case card for swapping the important pretend object at Puddle Planet Post Office: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, draw two paper parcel boxes, and place a pencil cap and paper clip beside the pretend counter: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Choose which pencil-case object matters first, then switch it and write what changes in the story: ____________________.
cards.switchFrontPrompt: Front switch: The pencil cap carries a tiny cloud stamp for ____________________.
cards.switchBackPrompt: Back switch: The paper clip carries a folded puddle note about ____________________.
cards.storySwitchPrompt: Story switch: Swap the object from pencil cap to paper clip, but keep the pretend post office job simple: ____________________.
cards.firstLineSwitch: First line switch: 'On Puddle Planet, the post office drawer rattled when ____________________ rolled forward.'
cards.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Make the chosen object do one clear story job before the ending: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Sketch the object and write one label beside it: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Take this card home and invent one more pencil-case parcel object: ____________________.

cards.title: Buttonwood Library Train Order Switch
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable pencil-case card for rearranging three pretend library train-car moments: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, fold the switch line, and ask the writer to mark three paper train cars A, B, and C: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write three tiny events, then switch the last event to the front and check what feels different: ____________________.
cards.switchFrontPrompt: Front switch: Car one opens with a buttonwood shelf bell and ____________________.
cards.switchBackPrompt: Back switch: The last car goes first, so ____________________ is now the beginning.
cards.storySwitchPrompt: Story switch: Swap the order of beginning, middle, and ending while keeping the same library train: ____________________.
cards.firstLineSwitch: First line switch: 'The Buttonwood Library Train clicked its pencil wheels when ____________________.'
cards.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Add one time word so the new order is easy to follow: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Number the three events silently and rewrite only the new first line: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Save the card and try the same order switch with a new library train scene: ____________________.

cards.title: Button Bakery Mix-Up Problem Switch
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable pencil-case card for switching the pretend mix-up on a paper Button Bakery map: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, set out colored pencils, and draw two simple paper labels for the button counter: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Choose one mix-up, write how the helper notices it, then switch to a different mix-up: ____________________.
cards.switchFrontPrompt: Front switch: The mix-up is a missing button label that should say ____________________.
cards.switchBackPrompt: Back switch: The mix-up is a dotted paper line that points to ____________________.
cards.storySwitchPrompt: Story switch: Swap the problem from missing label to mixed-up color key, and keep every detail fictional: ____________________.
cards.firstLineSwitch: First line switch: 'In Button Bakery, the pencil case snapped open when the paper map showed ____________________.'
cards.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Give the new problem one small clue before anyone solves it: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Draw the clue box and write just the changed problem: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Use this card to switch one more Button Bakery mix-up on paper: ____________________.

cards.title: Teacup Town Mood Window Switch
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable pencil-case card for changing the feeling of a fictional weather-window scene: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, draw one teacup window, and place two pencil color swatches beside it: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Pick one mood for the window, write a first line, then switch the mood and revise the same moment: ____________________.
cards.switchFrontPrompt: Front switch: The weather window feels curious because ____________________.
cards.switchBackPrompt: Back switch: The weather window feels patient because ____________________.
cards.storySwitchPrompt: Story switch: Swap the mood from curious to patient while keeping the same teacup town setting: ____________________.
cards.firstLineSwitch: First line switch: 'In Teacup Town, the pencil case clicked shut just as the weather window showed ____________________.'
cards.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Replace one plain feeling word with a detail the reader can picture: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Shade a tiny color square and write one mood clue under it: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Try the mood switch again with a new weather-window clue: ____________________.
